items.label: Soft Toy Organizer and Storage
items.value: We are really proud of our material, this stuffed animal storage is made of real thick wood, with strong bearing capacity and durability.

items.label: Large Capacity
items.value: The height of the toy storage can be adjusted from 44 inch to 71inch, perfect for holding lots of stuffed animal toys, you will be surprised by how many it can hold.

items.label: Cute Star Pattern
items.value: Each board have been engraved 4 stars, the corner stuffed animal toy storage not only can be used to organize the kids’ room, but also a wall decoration. Wonderful gift for girls, boys and Moms.

items.label: Space Saving
items.value: Designed for use on corner wall, this stuffed animal holder will not take up extra floor space. Fan-Shaped cutting, can make full use of the corner position, which will save a lot space for you. Great hanging toy organizer for kids playroom bedroom.

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Use
items.value: This stuffed animal toy storage comes with all hardware and instruction, easy to install. Thanks to the elastics, it is convenient for kids to access to their toys.

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Used to organize plush toys, stuffed animals.etc

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: kids bedrooms, nurseries, playrooms, storing plush toys or stuffed animals
